subject: Request: short-window retention carve-out for live debugging (Acme Payments integration)
messages:
From: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme-payments.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Lily Chen <lily.chen@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: need short hold on logs for debugging - integration failure

Hi Stephanie,

We hit a production failure on the Acme Payments connector this morning during live traffic replay. Our stack traces point to an issue on Redwood's side where KV cache entries for session ids 3f2b-9a7e-cc have been dropped. Our retention policy on the Acme side keeps only 7 days, and it looks like the relevant tokens were rotated and logs that would help root cause were already pruned.

Can Redwood make a short-term carve-out to retain/process any request traces and KV cache dumps matching the following correlation IDs for the next 72 hours? We only need a narrow slice for debugging:
- correlation_ids: 3f2b-9a7e-cc, 8e4d-11f2-7b
- endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/cache/kv
- approximate window: 2027-03-18 00:00 UTC -> 2027-03-21 23:59 UTC

We're running a hard cutover on Thursday; this is blocking our rollback plan. Attached is a small sample of the client-side logs that show the request flow (acme_debug_sample.txt).

If we need to sign anything or go through a compliance checklist, let us know. This is high priority for Acme—thanks.

—Jamal
Director, Integrations
Acme Payments
[Attachment: acme_debug_sample.txt (text/plain)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Lily Chen <lily.chen@acme-payments.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: need short hold on logs for debugging - integration failure

Thanks Jamal — I see the sample and the correlation IDs. I can escalate and request a short retention carve-out, but I need to confirm the scope and get sign-off from compliance/security.

Quick questions to help scope the request:
- Confirm we only need logs/traces that match the two correlation IDs above (yes/no).
- Which account(s) / org IDs should we include (if multiple).
- Desired hold duration (you asked 72h; we sometimes approve shorter, 24–48h, depending on risk).

I'm looping in Connor (manager) to approve the business need and Evelyn from Security for the compliance checks. If you can reply with the answers above I'll start the approval flow and prepare the audit trail that Security needs.

I will also attach a redacted copy of our standard exception form for MSA/information retention if Acme needs to sign (acme_msa_redacted.pdf).

—Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

On Mon, Mar 22, 2027 at 09:12 AM Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme-payments.com> wrote:
> (original message)

From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme-payments.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: need short hold on logs for debugging - integration failure

Stephanie — I approve initiating a narrowly scoped retention carve-out to enable debugging. Conditions:
- Limit to the two correlation IDs provided by Acme.
- Start as a 48-hour hold from time of approval (we can extend if Security signs off).
- No broad access; only the on-call SRE and the Security engineer (Evelyn) may access the preserved artifacts.

Evelyn, please advise what additional controls you need and whether Legal needs to sign the redacted MSA.

Connor Obrien
Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme-payments.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: need short hold on logs for debugging - integration failure

Thanks — a few security controls required before we create any exception:
1) Scope: exact match on correlation_ids only (3f2b-9a7e-cc, 8e4d-11f2-7b). No wildcard retention.
2) Duration: start 2027-03-22T11:05:00-07:00, expire 2027-03-24T11:05:00-07:00 (48 hours).
3) Access: add ACLs limiting access to these principals only: connor_obrien@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, oncall-sre@redwood.com.
4) Audit: we will enable an audit flag so every read is logged and a playbook is attached to the incident.
5) Data handling: preserved artifacts must be encrypted at rest with customer key if available; otherwise redact PII.

Acme, please confirm in writing that you accept this narrow scope and duration and that the retained material will only be used for root cause. If you can sign the attached MSA redaction or provide a short authorization email, we can proceed.

I created a short internal ticket for the work: JIRA SVC-4521. If we cannot meet the controls above, we should instead run an on-demand export and provide the derived evidence rather than preserve raw KV entries.

—Evelyn Hart
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
[evelyn_hart@redwood.com]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jamal Reed <jamal.reed@acme-payments.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: need short hold on logs for debugging - integration failure

Jamal / Lily — thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming scope via reply to Evelyn (your confirmation email is included below). Per approvals from Connor and Evelyn, we implemented the following:

- Created a retention carve-out that preserves artifacts matching correlation_ids: 3f2b-9a7e-cc and 8e4d-11f2-7b.
- Duration: 2027-03-22T11:05:00-07:00 -> 2027-03-24T11:05:00-07:00 (48 hours).
- Access ACLs: connor_obrien@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com, oncall-sre@redwood.com.
- Audit logging enabled (reads will appear in SVC-4521).
- Attached: acme_msa_redacted.pdf (signed MSA redaction from Acme) and the sample log you sent.

If Acme needs an export of the preserved slice instead of raw access, we can produce a sanitized bundle and deliver it over the secure transfer link (see Drive folder above).

I'll keep this thread open until the hold expires and will post the audit summary in JIRA SVC-4521. Let me know if you need the window extended — we'll re-evaluate based on progress and Security sign-off.

Best,
—Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
